description: Local domain relationship graph built from the URL training corpus and the Cisco Umbrella popularity ranking
sources: Cisco Umbrella top-1M popularity ranking (top 10,000 domains, public ranking)
method: Hostnames and registrable domains are nodes. Edges encode subdomain relationships and lexical brand-lookalike relationships. Malicious labels come from the URL corpus; popular domains are added as benign-context nodes from the public Umbrella ranking. No WHOIS, DNS, IP or live reputation lookups were performed.
